name: Toksi
source:
Department of Chemistry; Rabbit + some sort of (mystical) bird

An undergrad able to store certain chemicals in her body and disperse them at will. She can be put to use as a diffuser or mosquito repellent.

An undergrad who understands that poisons and medicines are basically the same thing. The fact that she has both rabbit fur and bird down makes her quite... fluffy.
